decision_rule.final_label_rule: rainfall_wetness, relief, and runout_area must pass; at least 4 of 5 groups must pass.

primary_gt.rule: rainfall_wetness, relief, and runout_area must pass; passed_groups >= 4

criteria.description: Gives the exact final label, the 4 of 5 pass count, and mandatory_groups_pass as true.
criteria.name: Final label and pass count
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct pass count or mandatory-group result with an incomplete label.

criteria.description: Returns target_family, five group objects, threshold_pass_fail, final_label, and one_sentence_proof.
criteria.name: Requested JSON ledger shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct structure with one missing group or minor field-name drift.

criteria.description: Reports precipitation, antecedent share, relief, slope proxy, runout/area, speed, image-pair score, and exposure index within the stated tolerances.
criteria.name: Numeric anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 3-4 points for mostly correct values with one or two small arithmetic errors; award 1-2 points for copied values without the derived ratios.

criteria.description: Applies the five-source event-day mean, two-source antecedent mean, load/share calculation, and per-100,000 exposure normalization.
criteria.name: Rainfall and exposure formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct formulas with missing rounding or one omitted input source.

criteria.description: Applies haversine distance, arctangent slope proxy, road length divided by overrun area, and speed threshold.
criteria.name: Relief and runout formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct setup with a wrong distance convention or a missing speed comparison.

criteria.description: Marks all five threshold states correctly and derives the final label from the mandatory-groups plus four-of-five rule.
criteria.name: Threshold states and rule
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right label with one mistaken group state.

criteria.description: Keeps the proof concise and numeric, without adding unrelated narrative beyond the requested ledger.
criteria.name: Concise numeric proof
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct ledger with extra prose that does not change the result.
